features.reason: Multiple sort keys and NULL placement require T17
Native legacy MEAN clamps values below one; the oracle retains arithmetic mean semantics
Successful stage selection needs a generated staged-group fixture
Successful index-rule ordering needs a generated rule and binding fixture
SHOW TOP uses a separate persisted TopN rule, outside the SELECT capability fixture
Custom MATCH analyzers need generated analyzer/index fixtures
NULL equality is not SQL null equality; successful predicates need an explicit null-semantics contract
Storage encoding collapses empty and null arrays; distinct results need a storage and QL semantics contract
Relative/now and integer time forms need clock-controlled semantics and rejection witnesses
Legacy TIME comparisons are inclusive; strict operators at an existing row need a boundary contract
Quoted/dotted/keyword identifiers need a generated schema and escaping witnesses
Multiple groups need generated schema compatibility, deduplication and authorization fixtures
Field-only, bucket-only and default-width grouping need independent legacy result contracts
Empty/scalar/array and NULL/bytes/timestamp bindings need positional type and expansion witnesses
Ungrouped, empty and nullable/tag-target aggregation need independent legacy result contracts
Depth64/65, clause order and malformed/empty projection need generated boundary witnesses
